subject: baku
pitch:
Category: Fantastical creature.
Subject: baku, the dream-eating tapir spirit.
Style: ukiyo-e woodblock print.

spec.name: Baku, Dream-Eating Tapir Spirit
spec.description: A stylized ukiyo-e woodblock-print baku: a tapir-bodied spirit with a trunk-like snout, tiger paws, an ox tail and swirling indigo cloud-wreathed mane, standing in rest pose.
spec.layout: A long-bodied tapir-like beast facing +Z, standing on four sturdy legs with tiger paws. The front half is a deep indigo-black coat; a cream saddle band runs across the barrel and the belly and legs are cream, as on a tapir. The head is carried low and forward on a thick neck, with a long drooping prehensile snout, small round fringed ears, big golden ox-like eyes with heavy black outlines, and small curved ivory tusks. A curling Japanese-style cloud mane (vermilion and white swirl blades) runs down the neck and spine. Short tail with a tuft tipped in vermilion. Ukiyo-e style: bold black outline-coloured shapes, flat colour blocks, repeated wave and cloud (kumo) motifs as small parts, red seal-like markings on the shoulders and haunches, and vermilion flame-like wisps rising from the back. All colours are flat.

parts.builds: Barrel body as one loft over hips and chest in coat indigo, with a wide cream saddle band, cream belly sector, lighter coatLight back highlights, wave-pattern trim bands (small wave-blue crescents repeated) along the flanks, vermilion seal-style emblems (small square plus inner glyph) on shoulders and haunches, and a rump with the tail root. Includes the tail chain (tail1, tail2) as a tapered sweep ending in a vermilion and cloudWhite tuft of overlapping blades.
parts.attaches: Neck at neckBase, front legs at shoulderL/R, rear legs at hipL/R, tail at tailRoot, mane along spineTop.

parts.builds: Four sturdy legs, each a sweep through hip, knee and paw: indigo upper leg fading to cream lower leg and socks, with chunky tiger paws (dark pawDark rounded block, three toe bumps, pale claw spikes) on the floor. Cream fur-tuft blades at the elbows and hocks, a vermilion anklet ring on each leg, and a small cloud-swirl motif on each thigh.
parts.attaches: Top of each leg at shoulderL/R and hipL/R mounts, under the torso.

parts.builds: Thick neck sweep from neckBase to headPivot. Tapir head: a rounded skull, long drooping trunk-like snout (tapered sweep curving down, with a pink nostril tip and ink nostrils and cream upper lip patch), separate upper and lower jaw (jaw joint) with a small pink mouth interior, ivory curved tusks, large gold ox eyes with thick ink outlines, black pupils and white highlight, heavy ink brows with vermilion eyeshadow, round ears with cream rims and ink inner, whisker rods, and a vermilion forehead mark (third-eye flame emblem).
parts.attaches: Neck joins torso at neckBase; mane starts at the crown of the head; jaw hinges at jawHinge.

parts.builds: Signature ukiyo-e cloud mane: a row of overlapping extruded kumo cloud-scroll shapes and swirl blades running from the crown down the neck and along the spine to the rump, in a root-to-tip palette of indigo, wave blue, cloudWhite and vermilion, with ink outline layers beneath each lighter shape, and gold dot accents. Plus shoulder and haunch flame-wisps (vermilion and gold curved spikes) and a few floating wave-roundel discs (concentric rings of wave and cloudWhite) hovering near the back, attached by small stems to the mane.
parts.attaches: Sits on the torso spine along spineTop and on the neck top; starts at headPivot crown.
